script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(600) do
        VirtualUser:CaptureController()
        VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
    end
end)

local ACCOUNT_1_NAME = "class_eTerNal"
local ACCOUNT_2_NAME = "Evanderugem62"

local ACCOUNT = 1
if LocalPlayer.Name == ACCOUNT_2_NAME then
    ACCOUNT = 2
end

local function getOpponentName()
    return (ACCOUNT == 1) and ACCOUNT_2_NAME or ACCOUNT_1_NAME
end

local knifeModule = nil
local CombatRules = nil
local StateController = nil

local function loadModules()
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    if playerScripts then
        local controllers = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
        if controllers then
            local stateCtrl = controllers:FindFirstChild("StateController")
            if stateCtrl then
                pcall(function()
                    StateController = require(stateCtrl)
                end)
            end
            local combat = controllers:FindFirstChild("Combat")
            if combat then
                local knifeCtrl = combat:FindFirstChild("KnifeController")
                if knifeCtrl then
                    pcall(function()
                        knifeModule = require(knifeCtrl)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not CombatRules then
        pcall(function()
            CombatRules = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("CombatRules"))
        end)
    end
end

loadModules()

local function hitTarget(model)
    if not knifeModule or not CombatRules then return end
    local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hitPos = hrp and hrp.Position or model:GetBoundingBox().Position
    pcall(function()
        knifeModule:_ReportPredictedHit(model, CombatRules.AttackType.Knife, false, 1, nil, nil, hitPos)
    end)
end

local function getOpponent()
    local opponentName = getOpponentName()
    local plr = Players:FindFirstChild(opponentName)
    if plr then
        local char = plr.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            return char
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function isInMatch()
    if StateController then
        local success, result = pcall(function()
            return StateController:GetState("InMatchFirstPerson") 
                or StateController:GetState("ActiveMatch") 
                or StateController:GetState("InActualMatch")
        end)
        
        if success and result == true then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function getLeaveEvent()
    local duelService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DuelService")
    if not duelService then return nil end
    local rf = duelService:FindFirstChild("RF")
    if not rf then return nil end
    return rf:FindFirstChild("LeaveMatch")
end

local function isWinScreenReturnVisible()
    if StateController then
        local success, state = pcall(function()
            return StateController:GetState("WinScreen")
        end)
        if success and state == true then
            return true
        end
    end

    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then return false end

    local winScreen = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Winscreen")
    if not winScreen then return false end

    if winScreen:IsA("ScreenGui") and not winScreen.Enabled then
        return false
    end

    local returnFrame = winScreen:FindFirstChild("Return")
    if not returnFrame then return false end

    if returnFrame:IsA("GuiObject") and not returnFrame.Visible then
        return false
    end

    local button = returnFrame:FindFirstChild("Button")
    if not button then return false end

    if button:IsA("GuiObject") and not button.Visible then
        return false
    end

    return true
end

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(2.5) do
        pcall(function()
            if not isInMatch() then
                local opponent = Players:FindFirstChild(getOpponentName())
                if opponent then
                    local duelService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DuelService")
                    local RE = duelService and duelService:FindFirstChild("RE")
                    if RE then
                        if ACCOUNT == 1 then
                            local req = RE:FindFirstChild("RequestDuel")
                            if req then
                                req:FireServer(opponent.UserId)
                            end
                        else
                            local resp = RE:FindFirstChild("RespondToDuelRequest")
                            if resp then
                                resp:FireServer(opponent.UserId, true)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

local hasTriggeredLeave = false

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        local winVisible = isWinScreenReturnVisible()

        if winVisible and not hasTriggeredLeave then
            hasTriggeredLeave = true
            local leaveEvt = getLeaveEvent()
            if leaveEvt then
                pcall(function() leaveEvt:InvokeServer() end)
            end
        end

        local inMatch = isInMatch()
        
        if inMatch and not winVisible then
            hasTriggeredLeave = false
            if ACCOUNT == 1 then
                local opponent = getOpponent()
                if opponent then
                    local localChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if localChar then
                        local localHrp = localChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if localHrp then
                            local targetHrp = opponent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if targetHrp then
                                localHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetHrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    hitTarget(opponent)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end)
